summary: Comprehensive backend pytest suite executed against public URL — 24/24 tests passed (100%). Covered auth (register/login/me-via-Bearer-and-Cookie/logout/revocation), captures CRUD with cross-user authorization, file serving, public share endpoints, and AI chat with both text-only and real-image (shapes/colors/text) inputs using GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key. Verified MongoDB _id never leaks in any response. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Endpoint performs a redundant second db.captures.find_one() inside the line that fetches the owner (lines 396-399). It already excluded user_id from the first query, then re-queries to retrieve user_id. Functional but inefficient — should fetch user_id once or include it then strip before returning.

action_items: (Optional) Refactor /api/share/{share_token} to avoid the duplicate DB lookup for owner.
critical_code_review_comments: share_meta() does two db.captures.find_one calls back-to-back (lines 390 and 397) — minor inefficiency, recommend single fetch with user_id then drop before response.

make_session_token() concatenates two uuid4 hex strings (64 chars) prefixed with 'st_' — fine, but JWT_SECRET is loaded but never used (PyJWT imported but unused). Remove import or actually sign tokens with JWT.
register/login set cookie with secure=True, samesite='none' — correct for cross-site Chrome extension/dashboard, good.

init_storage() called once at startup; if it fails, every capture endpoint returns 500. Consider lazy retry on failure (currently storage_key remains None and put_object/get_object raise 500). In this run, storage was healthy.

/api/auth/session uses data.get('session_token') from Emergent OAuth as our primary key — if Emergent ever returns duplicates across users this could collide due to the unique index on session_token. Fine in practice but worth a guard.
Pydantic EmailStr requires email-validator package — confirmed installed (no errors), good.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login — brute force risk; consider adding before production.
AI chat persists messages with 'now' timestamp identical for both user+assistant rows; ordering relies on insertion order in find().sort(created_at, 1). Use separate timestamps for strict ordering.
test_credentials: Tests register fresh TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com on each run; alice@example.com/secret123 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md is also valid.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates ~3 transient TEST_-prefixed users + 1 capture (capture is soft-deleted at end). Users are not cleaned up — DB will accumulate TEST_ users across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Frontend not yet tested. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable as regression. Real PNG/JPEG generators (with shapes/colors/text) are inside the file — reuse for any future image-grounded AI tests. AI image test asserts reply contains at least one of: circle/rectangle/triangle/square/shape/red/blue/green/text/hello.
